name: Singita Faru Faru Lodge
positioning: Contemporary safari lodge in front of a busy waterhole beside the Grumeti River, inside Singita's 350,000-acre private reserve in the Serengeti
best_for: Safari travelers who want a riverside lodge on a private reserve
Guests who want walking safaris, a balloon safari and conservation visits alongside game viewing

facts.text: Faru Faru is set in front of a busy waterhole alongside the Grumeti River in the heart of the Serengeti.
The lodge overlooks the Grumeti River.
Faru Faru is set within Singita's 350,000-acre private reserve in northern Tanzania.
It is a contemporary African lodge with a relaxed approach to luxury.
The bedroom suites have oversized windows that bring the wilderness inside.
The cafe-style bar at the heart of the lodge spills over to the pool area and firepit.
Vast outdoor decks and multiple airy enclaves allow for intimate dining and drinks.
Activities include guided safari walks and bird-watching.
Activities include a hot air balloon safari.
Guests can visit an anti-poaching observation post and take community visits.
The Serengeti plains around the lodge see the annual wildebeest migration.
Faru Faru lists activities for families and offers wine experiences.

highlights.text: The lodge sits in front of a busy waterhole alongside the Grumeti River, in the heart of the Serengeti.
It lies within Singita's 350,000-acre private reserve in northern Tanzania.
Bedroom suites have oversized windows that bring the wilderness inside.
Guests can take a hot air balloon safari, guided safari walks or a visit to an anti-poaching observation post.
The cafe-style bar spills over to the pool area and firepit.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote wilderness location requires chartered flights for access.
WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing reflecting the lodge's exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes the lodge is not available for online booking; reservations are made by contacting WhataHotel.
